question: Should `isLoopbackHost` become a supported long-term Plugin SDK API, with the documented literal and hostname semantics proposed here?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands the shipped Plugin SDK surface and changes a Codex authentication trust decision; repository policy treats both public plugin APIs and dependency-backed Codex behavior as maintainer-visible compatibility boundaries.

options.title: Accept the focused SDK contract
options.body: Approve the loopback-only helper after confirming its documented semantics and real runtime proof across the migrated callers.

options.title: Keep classification private to core
options.body: Decline the new SDK export and instead provide a narrower owner-approved plugin/runtime seam if external plugin use is not intended.
